snippet.title: Black Abyss Zero Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5123200/Black_Abyss_Zero/

The peaceful sky of the world was torn apart.

Alongside a mysterious, massive rift, strange creatures that had never existed before began appearing across the world. The sudden calamity quickly brought the world to ruin, forcing the survivors to seek refuge from extinction within a massive shelter known as the **Cube Shelter**.

An endless wasteland. Mysterious creatures. And the end of the world, where no one has ever reached.

Entrusted with a mission from the goddess, you must venture into the unknown world known as the "Black Abyss".
